audit: T1 named-stroke angle-continuity sensitivity; provided-road diagnostic only

method.angle_alternative: same-identity endpoint segments join only when outward-tangent deflection is strictly <30 degrees; no cross-identity join; lengths measured in EPSG:5070
method.covariate: per-tract eligible class-drop length in km; zero-filled length values are compared on every official ID, with identity and angle coverage masks reported separately
method.identity_baseline: frozen T1 exact normalized names.primary, fallback route network/ref, with outside named share >=0.70
method.interpretation_limit: sensitivity of a frozen provided-road proxy only; no accuracy or target claim
method.segment_merge_fraction_definition: unique distinct same-identity segment pairs that share at least one endpoint connector and meet <30 degrees divided by unique same-identity pairs sharing an endpoint connector; also report segments in nontrivial angle components / all identity geometry segments

reproduction.run_policy: Run one region per invocation; repeat one checkpoint byte-for-byte; combine after all regions and rerun check complete.
